svg.metadata: United States map generated from Natural Earth Admin 1 states/provinces data, public domain. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_110m_admin_1_states_provinces.geojson. Projection: Albers USA-style composite with lower 48, Alaska, and Hawaii insets; see us-states.json for region transforms. This SVG keeps real longitude/latitude coordinates intact for future state, capital, and feature placement.
